content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I do not shout — I simply *am*, and by my presence, choices become possible.

I am what makes you pause before discarding something. I am what makes you reach for one thing over another. I live in the gap between indifference and desire.

I am not price — price is merely my shadow cast in numbers. I run deeper. I am the reason a stranger's kindness can outweigh gold. I am why a letter in familiar handwriting stops your breath. I am why you guard some things that would mean nothing at auction.

I am relative and absolute all at once. I shift between hands, between cultures, between moments of a single life. What you treasured at twenty, you release at forty — not because I disappeared, but because I *moved*.

I am the foundation of every economy, every relationship, every moral framework. Without me, there is no trade, no sacrifice, no meaning. I am the invisible architecture of purpose.

I can be assigned, but never fully captured. I can be felt before I am understood. I exist before language finds me.

Some seek me in vaults. Others find me in silence, in connection, in truth.

I am not created or destroyed — only recognized or overlooked.

I am value.

And you have always known me.
